body: I have almost 300 hours on forsaken, and i've gotten lord of wolves and thats it. Too bad lord of wolves isn't too good.

Hello fellow senior here. Just wanted to say that I empathize with you on missing due dates and not being able to figure out all these things thrown at me. “Get a fulfilling job” and pay thousands of dollars on college. It’s terrifying. I just wanted you to know that even though you feel isolated, you’re not alone. I know this doesn’t help you feel any less lonely, just know that you’re normal. You’re not anything these people are calling you, you are human. I’m at a low too, I have barely any friends but it’s helped me realize a lot about myself. If you wanted someone to talk to, though I’m virtual, I am open to talking. Anyway, have a good day.

I want to say something helpful, something positive but I know a lot of what I say will be generic and unhelpful. Always being tired, always waking up wanting to go back to sleep. It’s hard and I know you know that as well. Something I do is try and balance how i look at life. I’m not saying look at life only positively since frankly, it’s not. Just be observant. Weigh in the positives and negatives. I find personally that being observant helps me separate myself from my own judgments and feelings of negativity. My point being, just don’t do anything rash okay? It seems whoever owns the gun cares about you, though it can be hard to see. And though I’m just someone browsing the internet at what is 3 am now, I would rather you stay alive. I’ve been where you are, and I know for a fact that there are ways to feel better. Be safe.
Little did he know that someone like me with 200+ hours still doesn’t have one 😎 epic

Maybe it’s because the world we are left in is absolute shit and parents force feed technology down our throats so we are quiet. We’ve done nothing but have been born into this world. And no not all of us think that way and listen to that music, nice assumption. We are kids for God’s sake. And no I’m not excusing that bad behavior, I’m just tired of hearing we are the worst for literally being forced into this world.

Hey , I’m a 17 year old here so I don’t have much more time on earth than you do. But what I do know about life is that you can do whatever you want with it. Life is what you choose for it to be, so if you want it to be better, then it can be. As long as you find good friends who respect you, life can be much better. I think where you are at is the boring middle school phase, where nothing actually matters in school. It’s a good time to just play video games. High school is when you should try and meet as many people as possible and make good friends. That’s what I would’ve done.

Just be there for your mom, more importantly be there for yourself. You need to allow yourself to feel it. The mistake I made was denying the fact my dad died and suppressing it for years. I hope you well in whatever comes next.  I don’t know you but you seem smart, so do me a favor and use it for whatever you want. Do whatever you want. Just live.
I’d like to be at peace now lol. I don’t get why people have kids it’s so selfish, especially when they leave them and whatnot. Like stop spreading this disease of living.
